subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] mm/mempolicy: use SRCU for the weighted interleave state

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch updates the weighted interleave state in the Linux kernel's memory policy module to use SRCU (Schedulable RCU) instead of copying it into a scratch array on every call. This change allows for more efficient handling of concurrent access and reduces the need for synchronization, making the code more scalable and reliable.
